declarations.state_ownership: Owns the twelve co_* tables of migration 0048 (lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations/0048_co_outreach_core.sql:28-299), RLS on with service-role-only policies; organization_id is a client filter with ON DELETE CASCADE, not a per-login boundary (0048:5-11, lib/outreach/db.ts:4-8). Connector API keys and Gmail refresh tokens are in the Supabase Vault (migration 0049), only their reference in co_connector_accounts.credentials_ref (app/api/outreach/connectors/secret/route.ts:7-10, lib/outreach/google-oauth.ts:3-5). co_connector_usage, co_timeline_events and co_verified_emails have no code reference today (grep over app and lib).
declarations.behavior_ownership: Lead import, scoring and de-duplication (app/api/outreach/inbox, leads; lib/outreach/normalize.ts, scoring.ts), the Cold Gate and message lint (lib/outreach/cold-gate.ts:1-7), AI draft generation (app/api/outreach/messages/route.ts:88-228) and human review (PATCH :232-268), Gmail draft creation (messages/gmail-draft/route.ts), Gmail OAuth (connectors/gmail/authorize, oauth/callback; google-oauth.ts), suppression list, service profiles and follow-ups.
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP /api/outreach/{connectors, connectors/secret, connectors/gmail/authorize, connectors/gmail/oauth/callback, followups, inbox, leads, messages, messages/gmail-draft, service-profiles, suppression}; writes require canManageOutreach (owner/admin/operator, lib/ops-role.ts:110-112), reads rely on the middleware session. Outbound: Google OAuth and the Gmail API with the gmail.compose scope only (google-oauth.ts:1-10), Claude / OpenAI / Gemini through the AI gateway (lib/outreach/ai-claude.ts, ai-openai.ts, ai-gemini.ts). No webhook, no internal route, no Trigger task (grep packages/workflows/src/trigger for outreach: none).
declarations.invariants: Nothing is ever sent: the OAuth scope is gmail.compose, never gmail.send (google-oauth.ts:1-3), and generated text is stored as a draft (messages/route.ts:17-18, :217). drafted is set only after a successful Gmail API call, never by the client (gmail-draft/route.ts:9-12, :197). The daily draft limit is a live count of today's draft_created events on the Asia/Taipei day (gmail-draft/route.ts:126-141). The Cold Gate refuses generation without an observation and source_url, or for a do_not_contact lead, with 422 (messages/route.ts:112-116, cold-gate.ts:3-5). Raw keys never reach a normal table (connectors/secret/route.ts:7-10). Drafts need the outreach.draft grant, billed to the lead's organization (messages/route.ts:173-177).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (co_* tables and the vault of migration 0049), the customer's Google OAuth client (GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET, connectors/gmail/authorize/route.ts:28-29), AI provider keys per organization or agency from the vault, not env (messages/route.ts:139-164), the entitlement gate. Code import inside the same app: actorFor from lib/social/authz (messages/route.ts:11, :176); products.ts dependsOn is empty. No Trigger, no schedule job. Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row outreach.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: A vault error on one provider moves on to the next provider (messages/route.ts:160-163); provider failure or no key falls back to a manual_prompt draft with the error kept in ai_model (messages/route.ts:189-198). lib/outreach/db.ts helpers fail soft (db.ts:10). A Gmail draft whose status update fails returns a warning, not an error, so a retry does not create a duplicate draft (gmail-draft/route.ts:191-199).
declarations.data_lifecycle: Hard delete only, through the DELETE handlers of connectors, inbox, leads, messages, service-profiles and suppression (app/api/outreach/*/route.ts); co_messages cascade with their lead, co_sending_events keep their row with lead and message set null (0048:138, :260-261); deleting an organization cascades every table (0048 foreign keys). No soft delete, no retention job.
declarations.observability_contract: Each draft keeps prompt_snapshot, evidence_snapshot, ai_model and lint scores (messages/route.ts:204-216); co_sending_events records draft_created with the Gmail draft id (gmail-draft/route.ts:179-188). There is no logAiCall, Sentry or console logging in lib/outreach or app/api/outreach (grep: none); errors surface only in HTTP responses.
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: 0048 has lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts/0048_co_outreach_core_down.sql, which drops all twelve tables in reverse foreign-key order and destroys all outreach data (header :1-5); it is run by hand.
declarations.replacement_strategy: Each AI provider is its own client file called with (grant, key, prompt) (ai-claude.ts, ai-openai.ts, ai-gemini.ts); Gmail is isolated in google-oauth.ts. The provider order claude -> openai -> gemini -> gemini_agency -> manual is fixed in messages/route.ts:131-133, so swapping a provider means editing that route.

configuration.apiKeys: The customer's Google OAuth client (GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET); AI provider keys are entered per organization into the vault through /api/outreach/connectors/secret, not env. Optional model overrides CLAUDE_OUTREACH_MODEL, OPENAI_OUTREACH_MODEL, GEMINI_MODEL (lib/outreach/ai-claude.ts:12, ai-openai.ts:12, ai-gemini.ts:15).
configuration.generatedByInstall: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL = the installation's own app URL, used for the OAuth redirect (lib/outreach/google-oauth.ts:61)
configuration.installUnit: Each services entry names the service this product calls; the installer installs that entry's whole compose file (ADR 017 section 5 inventory).
